Question two. After a long journey, you finally reach a forest, where the fog is as thick as Milk. You're completely lost! Then you come upon three paths, each of which looks... well, interesting. Which one will you follow?
The path prowled by beasts
The desolate trail
The road to the ancient castle
Whether your future takes you through forest paths echoing with Orc roars, along desolate trails, or into the depths of an ancient castle, never forget the burning courage within your heart.

Question three. After facing countless dangers and battling terrifying monsters, you finally emerge victorious! Now a dust-covered treasure chest lies before you, with light shining through its keyhole! You rub your hands together, your heart pounding. What treasure do you hope to find inside?
An ancient divine weapon
A forbidden spellbook
Water from the Spring of Renewal

At the end of every story, heroes grasp the blades of divine weapons, open the covers of spellbooks, and scoop up the shimmering waters of sacred springs. But never forget what first set you on your journey.
All right, you've completed every test. Please wait while I determine your results...
Ta-da! The Crystal of Fate has revealed your result! Let's see... Oh? Not bad!
The soul of a Swordsman burns within you! A Lion lives in your heart, courage is your blade, and protection is your shield. Go forth—the Prontera Chivalry awaits!
So, how accurate was Erpi's reading? Don't dawdle—go complete your Job Advance! The legend of Midgard is yours to write.

What a warm light... It's the calling of an Acolyte! Your heart is as soft as a Poring, yet your strength surpasses that of an angel. Remember, your hands, which can heal anything, are more precious than any weapon.
Wow! What a mysterious magical glow... Your head must be filled with stars and arcane runes. Those old scholars in Geffen Tower will be fighting over you!

Shh! The shadow of the Thief has chosen you. Your footsteps are lighter than the wind, and your eyes are sharper than a hawk's. The black market of Morroc... Ahem, I mean the whole wide world awaits your talents!
I hear the sound of Zeny... You have the makings of a Merchant! There's an abacus clacking away in your head, isn't there? Remember to give me a discount when you open your shop!
Whoosh! Right on target—the eagle eye of an Archer! You like to keep your Distance, wait for the perfect moment, then strike true. Hey, you might just become the greatest Archer in Payon!
Mm-hmm, just leave it there... Wait, aren't you here to deliver food?
Tell him your intent
Oh! You're the new recruit from the Eden Group! My eyesight's just like my Lain's—I can't tell people from animals at five meters, and at ten meters, the whole world's one big happy blur. Hahaha!
The gyroscope... Let me think. Its core needs sturdy spacers, and Stag Beetle shells have just the right density. Bring me some ^{1}【Hard Shells】^{2} from Stag Beetles.

I'll also need a barrel of ^{1}【High-Quality Sticky Mucus】^{2} from Willows to use as damping fluid. The last time I went looking for some, I mistook a regular tree for a Willow and spent half an hour talking to it...

Finally, I'll need ^{1}【Eddga's Mane】^{2} for the balancing bristles. That big cat has been prowling around the bamboo forest lately, terrifying the villagers... and making so much noise I can't focus on my experiments! Go bring me some of its mane—and quiet it down while you're at it.
That big cat isn't easy to find. Ask the old Hunter in the forest if he knows its exact location.
I'm here to collect the mount.
Here you go.
You're a new face. This forest's been dangerous lately, so don't wander around without good reason.
Ms. Emma sent me.
I'm looking for Eddga.
Oh? That old lady with the poor eyesight? This is about the airship, isn't it? Eddga's mane... Yes, that certainly sounds like something she'd need.
That beast is clever and always on the move. It won't just sit in one place waiting for you to find it.
Here, take this. It's called a ^{1}【Fly Wing】^{2}. Crush one, and it'll teleport you a random Distance through this bamboo forest.
It's a common trick among Adventurers. You rely on luck to cross paths with it. Whether you find it is up to chance.
Is this... really going to work?
Thanks. I'll give it a try.
It beats wandering aimlessly through the forest like a headless fly. Back in our day, this was how we tracked down elusive monsters like that.
Good luck. Remember, if you encounter Eddga, approach it carefully. That beast is ferocious.
You're back. How did it go?
I found all the materials.
Oh? That was fast. Hmm... The materials all meet my standards. Excellent! You're far more capable than that silly boy of mine who does nothing but read.

Speaking of Lain... That boy's a hopeless bookworm. He can't think about anything but his research. If the royal family hadn't personally commissioned the Eden Group to find him, I'd be afraid he'd get himself lost in the desert...

Haha, don't worry! Our leader is handling this personally, and with such a capable new recruit helping us, we'll bring Professor Lain back safe and sound. He's essential to the research on the 【Nail of World Law】. We'll protect him with our lives!
All right, rookie. Excellent work on the mission. The airship is ready, so it's time to meet up with the others. Your true adventure is about to begin!
Boya, wait here for a moment. I'll give you the repaired gyroscope. ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, this Card is for you. It should be very helpful on your adventures ahead.
^{1}PlayerName^{2}, go learn all about Cards first. They're essential for every Adventurer. I'll meet you at the village entrance later.
Go find the black market merchant at the tavern.
All right, I'm on my way.
I'm the proprietor NPC. I don't know where the black market merchant is, either.
All right, I'll ask someone else.
I'm the veteran Adventurer NPC. I don't know where the black market merchant is, either.
I'll take a look inside.
The threads of your fate... are entwined with some very intriguing possibilities. There is a certain... “special” energy emanating from you.
Who are you?
What do you mean by “special”?
(Takes a wary step back)
Time... is a one-way road for your kind. But every so often, ripples appear.
This old compass is yours. It will warn you before disaster strikes.
When a great crisis approaches, it will guide you. Use it wisely...
Who were you just talking to? There's no one here.
Could you be under some kind of illusion? Maybe there's a fox spirit or something lurking near Payon...
Whoa! Could it be a ghost?! So scary, so scary~
Master~ Have you been secretly dating an invisible girl?
Knock it off, Bobo...
Anyway, we need to get moving. The Eden Group Captain is still waiting at the ^{1}Airship Port in Izlude^{2}. If we take any longer, she's going to be furious.
Black Market Merchant, I'll come by later to buy a ticket.
All right, I'll be there soon.
Would you like to buy a ticket?
^{1}One ticket, please^{2}
You already have a ticket? Then I'll teleport you there.
Please teleport me.
Captain! We got the gyroscope, and ^{1}PlayerName^{2} did a great job!
Excellent work. Rookie, welcome to the operation. This is Instructor Wulf. Relax—from now on, we'll Fight Alongside each other.
Hello, rookie. The supplies have been inventoried. We can board whenever you're ready.
Time is short, so I'll be brief. Our mission is to travel to the ^{1}Sograt Desert^{2} and find the missing Professor Ryan.
This is a covert mission. The professor's research is crucial to the kingdom's future, so the fewer people who know about it, the better.
Rhyne and Boya have both reported on your previous performance. You've proven that you're capable and dependable. Welcome to the team.
We'll take the 【White Dove】 cargo airship to Morroc, at the entrance to the desert. If there's anything else you'd like to know, ask me now.
I don't have any questions.
Who is Professor Ryan?
Who commissioned the mission?
What is the 【White Dove】?

Good eye! The 【White Dove】 belongs to Valkyrie Air, and it symbolizes the cooperation between the Papal State and the Republic. It's officially a cargo ship, but it still has a passenger cabin, making it perfect for a team that needs to keep a low profile.
Its structure has been Enhanced, giving it greater speed and stealth than an ordinary passenger ship. It's also equipped with basic defensive cannons.
Wulf knows this ship inside and out. Don't worry—he's a dependable old friend.
Understood.

He's one of the kingdom's foremost scholars and studied abroad in Juno. He specializes in ancient magic technology and is... a somewhat absentminded genius. He's the key to unraveling the mystery of the 【Nail of World Law】.
His safety is our highest priority.
Exactly. That's why we have to find him.
This commission comes directly from the royal family. That means it's a high-level mission, and it also means... the potential danger may be beyond anything we can imagine.
So don't worry. Just follow my lead. I'll bring every one of you back safely. I always Keep my word.
All right, no more questions, then. Keep your ticket handy, rookie. Prepare to board—next stop, Morroc!
Good afternoon. Please present your boarding pass and confirm that your carry-on luggage is not overweight.
Pass confirmed. The White Dove has been cleared for departure, and its engines are warmed up. We expect to depart in three minutes.
Are you ready to board now?
^{1}Confirm Boarding^{2}
Wait a little longer.
Have a pleasant journey. May the winds grant you clear passage.
We're off, we're off! Up into the clouds!
All right. Please board before the departure horn sounds. We will not wait for late passengers.
Huh? Is something still not ready? Bobo can't wait any longer, bo!
Well, rookie? This is your first time seeing the view from an airship, isn't it?
Ready to go? Just don't throw up on the ship.
^{1}I'm ready^{2}
I'm not ready.
You have another @{1} minutes. Don't dawdle.
Then... let's be off. White Dove, launch!
Finally awake, huh? You were really out cold.
Hahaha! Welcome back to the land of the living! After that crash, I thought you'd be getting up close and personal with the sand for three days and three nights!
Wah... Stupid Master! You scared Bobo half to death! Bobo thought the crash had broken your head!
All right, everyone's here. Looks like the White Dove is a total loss, and there's no point going to Morroc now.
According to Wulf, our landing site is actually closer to our destination, the ^{1}【Adventurer Camp】^{2}. Let's rest briefly, then move out.
To help you survive the battles ahead, I have some spare materials you can use to repair your weapon.
Go ahead, Master! Bobo thinks it'll become super—powerful, bo~
Oh? Eikuni, long time no see! Are you here in the desert to Complete the Commission?
Hahaha, of course I'm here for work. It's been a while, Hawke. How have you been?

Same as always. Ant breeding season is almost here, and there have been frequent Adventurer disappearances lately. It's a real headache... But enough about that. You must have something more important to discuss, right?
Yes. I'm looking for someone. Have you seen a scholar named Levin recently? He wears glasses, has very poor eyesight, and is quite refined.
Levin, glasses, poor eyesight... Is he from Payon? And didn't he study in Juno?
Yes, that's him! Do you know where he went?

He's been staying at the camp for the past week, leaving early and returning late every day. Oh! I even said hello to him before he left this morning. He took his equipment to ^{1}【Ant Hell】^{2} again at the crack of dawn, saying he was going to collect some kind of 【Memory Particles】. He's incredibly stubborn. I tried to convince him to take someone with him, but he wouldn't listen.
That's a relief. At least he's safe. But Ant Hell is dangerous. We need to find him and make sure nothing happens.
I'll leave finding the professor to you for now. I need to report the White Dove disaster to headquarters first. As soon as that's taken care of, I'll meet up with you.
Master, looks like it's up to the two of us this time!
Pick Up the Notes
Hey! Professor, are you okay?!
Huh? Where did this... giant talking Chonchon come from? Or is it a living ball of soot?
You're the Chonchon! Your whole family's made of soot! Bobo is a noble Demon Poring! Get a good look, bo!
Uh... Adventurer? Thank You for helping me, but may I ask who you are...?
Introduce Yourself
Go back? But my research is at a critical stage, and the energy readings here are unprecedented! If I stop now, all my work could be for nothing.
Insist on Taking the Professor Back
...Fine, fine. Since you insist, I'll go back with you. But give me a little more time to finish one last sample.
Actually, before that, could you do me a favor? Look over there, in the corner...
That ^{1}【poor girl】^{2} hasn't moved at all. Could she be injured? Oh, it's chilly in this cave. Do you have any spare clothes? Please help her.
Master, that lady looks a little strange... But maybe the professor got it right this time? There really is someone over there!
Are you alright?
Why is it just the two of you? Where are the captain and the others? ...You didn't find Professor Levin?
Explain What Happened
I knew it! The Adventurers who've disappeared in the desert over the past few months weren't lost or taken by bandits... They've probably all become the queen ant's emergency food supply!
There may be one enormous ant colony beneath this entire desert. What we discovered before was only the tip of the iceberg.
Wh-Whoa... M-M-Master! Doesn't that mean we're standing on the lid of one giant cooking pot?!
Aquinnie and the others haven't returned yet, and there's no one at the camp to spare for a rescue mission.
This ^{1}【Pathfinder Ant】^{2} is a Piere we captured. It's instinctively drawn to the queen ant's pheromones. Release it inside Ant Hell, and it'll lead you to the entrance of the queen's nest.
But I recommend waiting for the captain to return before taking action. The situation down there is far worse than we imagined. Going in alone would be suicide.
Professor Meat Is Sour, So Ants Won't Eat It
Wait for Reinforcements
It's Extremely Risky, but There's No Other Choice
Silly Master... Are ants vegetarians? And how do you know the professor tastes too sour to eat?! What kind of reason is that?!
This rescue mission will be exceptionally difficult. If you're determined to go, consider bringing a pet into battle. It could be a great help.
Master, do you have another little pet when I'm not around? Boo-hoo... Bobo's being abandoned...
Ahem. Bobo, was it? There's a big difference between combat pets and companion pets. Don't worry. A companion pet with as much personality as you could never be replaced.
I'll Never Abandon Bobo
That Depends on How You Do
Hmph! By the time reinforcements arrive, the professor will already have become... become you-know-what! You're not usually this scared, Master.
Don't worry! When the time comes, you can hide behind Bobo, Master!
Sniff... You're right, Master. The professor can't wait that long! Bobo... Bobo will protect you, bo!
I knew you were the best, Master!
Master, you've gotten mean!
Teleport into the Instance
There you are! Are you both okay?
Oh, you know. We only nearly got eaten by the queen ant.
Next time something like this happens, don't go off on your own. You must wait for us to return. Come on, let's head back to camp.
Oh, you're here... Thank You for rescuing me. You were a tremendous help.
I actually came here to extract this—^{1}【Memory Form】^{2} . You can think of it as energy formed from intense human emotions and memories.
I've spent several months investigating the area around the desert. I managed to Discover that the queen ant's mimicry actually came from a girl she devoured, so I came here to search for a Clue...
I finally managed to find some samples, but then... uh, I nearly got eaten.
But I got it in the end! Look—(Raises bottle)
Take the Memory Form
You're awake. It brought you back here after all... somewhat sooner than I expected.
Welcome to the ^{1}【Garden of Time】^{2}—the crossroads of countless possibilities and the final resting place of every unfinished story.
The compass in your hand can do far more than foresee danger.
And what you just experienced was but one insignificant note in a grand symphony.
Curious about this place? Feel free to look around. I'll be waiting up ahead.
You've arrived. Are you... satisfied with the view?
Those drifting visions are worlds that once truly existed—some have already withered away, while others continue to Struggle.
And you will be among those who decide their fate.
Wow! It's so beautiful here! Much comfier than Master's Backpack~
But... why does this place feel kind of familiar?
...You little troublemaker.
What happened just now? You suddenly froze up and even broke the thoughtform storage vial!
Did the desert heat give you heatstroke? You look awful.
It's okay! Master just got scared by some ants earlier, that's all~ Right?
Never mind. Good thing I have a backup. Let's head back to Prontera for now.
Let's go. The airship wreckage recovery team should have arrived by now.

Jack says he knows a pest-control expert who can drive away the Rockers. What can you do?
Jack's the one who hired you, isn't he? Don't worry, I already have a plan! Rockers love Whispering Flowers. We can use them to lure the Rockers out into the wild!
You're a quick thinker, young man. All right, I'll trust you this once.
Don't worry, we've got this! We'll go pick the flowers right now!
Finished already? Young folks sure are quick on their feet. Come on, I'll take you to my house.
This is my house. See if you can lure them into the woods to the south.
^{1}PlayerName^{2}, You place the Whispering Flower. I'll build them a little stage at the destination. Once we lure them out, they'll need somewhere to settle down.
Everything's just about ready. Now let's see if the Rockers take the bait.
Well, I'll be... Those little rascals really came! Look how happily they're bouncing around!
Now these old bones can finally get a good night's sleep! You're good kids. You're a hundred times more capable than that braggart Jack!
I'll talk to my old friends too and tell them to stop helping Jack bully decent folks!
As soon as you and Lemon approach, old Bob straightens his back and pretends to be diligently holding the spot.
(Helplessly) Grandpa, why put yourself through this?
(Stares at the ground, guilty but defiant) Enough! This old man... I just like standing here and breathing the fresh air! What, do you own this place?
(Suddenly notices something) Grandpa, why are your pant legs all torn up? It looks like something's been biting them.
You bet! It's a pack of those blasted white rats! Snow-white fur, bright red eyes—they look downright fancy, but act like a bunch of bandits!
I don't know why, but they've made themselves at home in my yard and wreak havoc every day. Forget the pants—they've even gnawed a hole through the base of the wall!
That kid—oh, Jack—said he could get the best mousetraps in town... as long as I keep sitting here for him for a few more days...
Mousetraps? Those are so old-fashioned! Take us to the fields, and we'll take care of it right away!
If you... if you really have a plan, old Bob here will get up and go right now! Sitting in this dump is killing my back!
You got it, you got it! Let's go!
This is the place. Look, they're still poking their heads out! They've got some nerve!
Start Catching Rats
(Tears streaming down his face) Incredible! Simply incredible! That Jack is all talk—he's been pulling the wool over my eyes! You two are the ones who actually get things done!
Don't worry. I won't let Jack rope me into any more of his nonsense. I'll tell my old friends not to go, either.
Hahaha! I may be getting on in years, but I'm an elder here. My word still carries some weight.
Great! ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, it looks like our plan to Win them over one by one is Active. Let's go tell everyone the good news!
J-Just you wait! You have no idea who you're messing with! I've got powerful friends!
Oh? You mean Elder Bob? We've already "bought him off"!
What?! You got me! But this isn't over! You can have this turf—I'll find somewhere else!
(Shouting) Everyone heard that, right? Step up patrols for the time being. Don't give this guy a chance to cause trouble!
Understood. I'll send out patrols to drive off any troublemakers who threaten the village's peace.
Your timing is perfect. Jack just got a sound thrashing from ^{1}PlayerName^{2}!
(His face turns purple) Y-you... Remember this!
You came at just the right time! I've got a fresh batch of treasures, still hot off the forge!
Take a gander at this 【Iron-Slicing Sword】! Look at that grain! Hear that ring!

(Flicks the blade with a finger, making it ring with a crisp hum) Forged from fine southern steel and personally quenched by the apprentice of a distant cousin of a dwarven Moonlit Challenger! One swing turns a Poring into sashimi and a Dummy into a toothpick!
I like you, so I'll give you an honest price! I'd charge anyone else @{1} Copper Coins for this sword, but if you're serious, it's yours for @{2}!
What do you say, Adventurer? This is a rare opportunity—how about buying one?
A distant cousin's apprentice?
How about @{1} copper coins?
I'm not interested.

Ahem... well... great teachers produce great students! This craftsmanship was passed down by a true master! Just look at the workmanship, the attention to detail—it's absolutely Moonlit Challenger caliber!
(Clutches chest) You drive a harder bargain than this sword's edge! That wouldn't even cover the cost!

Ah, brave adventurer! A moment, please! I couldn't help but notice your keen eye as you surveyed the market—and the tremendous potential within you! Those are not the eyes of someone destined for mediocrity!
Look at these plodding masses! They're content with an ordinary steel sword and a cheap potion! But not you! I can tell by your stride that you yearn to rise above the ordinary!
Tell me, have you ever gazed up at the stars and wondered how you could finally live up to your gifts and truly... live?

(Leans in slightly and lowers their voice) The Adventurers' Guild is looking for exceptional people just like you! We're not offering you a mere job, but the ultimate opportunity to rewrite your destiny and rise to the top!

Don't just take my word for it—please accept this invitation. We're hosting an exclusive welcome gala at the most luxurious venue in town, the 【Oak Tavern】! There'll be endless gourmet food and fine wine, not to mention countless elite Members who've already achieved the life of their dreams!
Give me one evening, and I'll prove that everything you've worked for has merely been preparing you to join us! What do you say? Will you give yourself a chance to reach out and touch the future?
Turn and Leave
Accept the Invitation
Now that's character! I admire your candor! But believe me, a promise from Jax carries more weight than adamantine! Come see for yourself, and you'll know I speak the truth!
(Overjoyed) Wise! Incomparably wise! Come with me—our future begins with this dinner!
(Wiping away tears) Ever since my husband joined his guild, he hardly ever comes home. The last time I saw him was three months ago...
The last time my son came home to get some clothes, his eyes were bloodshot, and he could barely stay awake on his feet! He called it “voluntary extra training,” but I say he’s been brainwashed!
Dear families! Please understand! This is all for a happier future! They're all willingly striving for their dreams! This brief separation will lead to a joyous reunion!
Come with me, everyone! Once you see them hard at work, you'll understand just how happy they are!
John, the last time you came home was three months ago. You ate, said you'd wash the dishes later, then rushed off for an “emergency assembly.” I've been waiting for you to wash them ever since.
Ah! Now I remember! Don't worry, honey. Once we defeat the Giant Kun, we can use His Majesty's reward to buy a set of solid-gold dinnerware!
Oh? Should I learn a “turn stone into gold” spell first, so the two of us don't starve into statues before those solid-gold plates ever show up?
(Staring blankly) Last night, I dreamed I was fighting monsters... I was even more efficient than during the day... If only it were real.
Come on, child. Let's go home. You need a good night's sleep.
I thought I saw my mother. She should be in the Mjolnir Mountains. I must be dreaming again...

New here? I've got a 【Hardcore Grinder's Secret Elixir】 that'll keep you sharp and alert, even if it burns through your Life. It works like a charm—I use it myself! You look like a good sort, so I'll charge you just 8 tenths of the regular price!
(Hands on hips) Burning through your Life? I keep you well-fed and comfortable, and you're here burning through your Life?
H-Honey, it's just a figure of speech! It's all to make money, to make money...
Well? Aren't our Members fired up? Now make your choice! Will you join us and build the future together? Or... settle for mediocrity among those who cannot comprehend our lofty ideals?
Reject
Join
Heh, to each their own. What a shame. Please accept this small gift as a Thank You for your help earlier. May life always be so... “easy” for you.
Excellent—a wise choice! Welcome to the Fighters' Guild. Here's your signing bonus!
Hello! What can I get for you?
One sandwich, please.
All set—I've packed it up for you. Thanks for your business!
Ah, a sandwich! Thank you so much! I can't get delivery out here, and I'm practically starving.
I called you all the way out here to show you this! My masterpiece—the 【Pseudogyne Pheromone】! One spritz, and the Giant Ants will treat you like their queen!
Well, well. Looks like someone's already forgotten the time the ants carried you off like a takeout order??
C-Captain! That was valuable field data, and this time, I have a flawless product of science. Emotions lead to mistakes, but science never does.
All right, great scientist. Should I send a team of Adventurers with you so you don't get carried off again?
N-No need to trouble yourself. This reliable warrior here is all I need to assist with the test...
Fine. You two stay safe. But Professor, if anything goes wrong again, the Order may have to... temporarily take charge of your personal freedom.
It a-absolutely won't! I'm confident there won't be any problems this time.
That's good. Hey, ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, I'm leaving this remarkable Professor in your care. Don't let him get too carried away.
^{1}PlayerName^{2}, here—take my precious [Pseudo-Queen Pheromone]. Don't drop it! Just sprinkle it on You.

It's a resounding success! It's so docile around you—far beyond my expectations. This proves the bond created by the pheromone is stable and emotionally grounded. I imagine riding it will go smoothly too...

Captain Aikuni, do you see this? Such a gentle temperament! Such a powerful physique! This will be a revolutionary innovation! Giant ants could become stronger, more Excellent mounts than Peco Pecos. And according to my research, their adaptability to difficult terrain is also Excellent.
Professor, the most important quality in a proper mount is reliability. My Peco Peco won't suddenly throw its rider off or... ahem, develop any unnecessary [Romantic Feelings]. Safety first, right?

...That's prejudice! A conservative attitude toward unknown technology! My giant ant's pheromones have been calibrated, and its stability has been calculated. Your Peco Peco is the one that's... a featherbrain!

Oh? A featherbrain, maybe, but at least it won't turn your research into another rescue mission. So you think your "calculations" can beat the reliability Peco Pecos have proven over thousands of years?
O-Of course! Science is about constantly challenging and surpassing tradition.
Talk is cheap. As it happens, I know an abandoned Peco Peco racetrack. How about a race between your giant ant and my Peco Peco? Let the results speak for themselves. Unless... you're afraid?
You're on! My research will never lose to some bird! PlayerName, let's head to the racetrack.
Hahaha! All right. Let me know when you're ready.
Well? Ready to face my Peco Peco?
Not Yet
Sigh... The specimen is gone, and I didn't even finish recording the valuable field data. But! This incident proves there's one crucial area where my theory can be improved—

Pheromone stability is positively correlated with the host's physiological state. The adrenaline or some other metabolic byproduct produced during the race must have interfered with normal pheromone receptor binding. This wasn't a failure—it eliminated one major false lead!
Professor, are you saying you plan to continue your research? That thing nearly ate all three of us!

Every great innovation comes with risks. Juno's first airship didn't get far on its maiden flight either. I need to adjust the formula's concentration and application method—not abandon the entire field of research.

All right, I get it. Stopping you from doing research is harder than making an ant obey. But Professor, we're setting some ground rules. Before your next experiment, you must submit an "Extremely Detailed Safety Plan" to me.
The caravan was attacked again? By Baphomet? Peace has been hard to come by in that area lately. Professor, did you have more important equipment shipped here?
Wh-What?! W-Where did you say? The Black Forest?! Baphomet?! No, no, no! This is a disaster!
Is it that important? If necessary, we can find a way to get you another one. I have some connections in Juno—
It's not equipment! It's alive! There's something alive in that crate!
What? Alive?
Professor, be clear. What do you mean by "alive"? What kind of creature did you ship? Don't tell me you've violated the kingdom's safety regulations again!

It's [Little Bean]! An old classmate of mine in Juno could no longer care for the kitten, so they entrusted [Little Bean] to me. I-If Glenn finds out I lost Little Bean, he'll never speak to me again...
So it's a pet cat. Professor, what were you thinking? Why didn't you transport it by airship?
I heard animals sometimes suffocate in airship cargo holds, so I specifically hired a company that transports animals overland... What do I do? What am I going to do?!
Enough! This is no time to panic. We need to head to the scene immediately and find that cat before Baphomet—or anything else—can hurt it.
^{1}PlayerName^{2}, the situation has changed. This is no longer a simple search for cargo. We have to act. Let's leave immediately.
Hello! Are you the reliable Adventurer Captain Aikuni mentioned? It's a pleasure to meet you. You're here about the bounty notice, correct?
To be honest, this case has us stumped. There have been three thefts in the city recently, but the victims and stolen items are completely different. We can barely find anything they have in common.

The first victim was Blacksmith Hollgrehenn. He lost a fine sword. The second was Nita, a young woman who lives on the west side of the city. She lost a piece of jewelry. The third was a Mage from Geffen who reportedly had a very important spellbook stolen.
We didn't uncover much in the way of a Clue during our interviews... You should visit them yourself. You may Discover some detail in their accounts that we overlooked.
Hey! A new face! Are you an Adventurer looking to refine your gear? Then Hollgrehenn's your man! Bring me good materials, and I'll hammer your gear as high as you dare!
About the Bounty Notice
Oh, that. Yeah, I lost a fine weapon. A longtime customer left it with me to Enchant. Sigh... I really let them down after they placed their trust in me.
Describe What Happened

Honestly, I don't remember how it vanished. The shop was packed that day, and I was running all over the place. I left the weapon on that rack, turned away for a moment, and it was gone. Who did it? What did they look like? I don't remember a thing.
Recall Anything Unusual

Something unusual? Now that you mention it... Heh, there was one thing. Just before closing, a particularly... uh... passionate lady came into the shop. And the way she was dressed... Whew! She was like a blazing flame!
What Did the Lady Do?
She didn't really do anything. She just watched me smithing for quite a while. Then she came over, leaned in real close, and said I looked so strong and manly while working the forge...

I'd never heard anything like that before! My heart was pounding, and my head got all fuzzy. She complimented me a few times, then left with a smile without buying anything. It still makes me happy just thinking about it! Haha!
But happy as it made me, the weapon is still missing. Sigh... I wish I could be more help. You don't think that beautiful lady took it, do you? She didn't look like a bad person.
Welcome! Would you like a bouquet for someone special? The birds of paradise look especially vibrant today!
Oh, you mean my gold ring... It was the most precious thing my mother left me. I always took such good care of it. I truly don't understand how it could have disappeared.

That day... I was tending the flowers and helping customers, just like always. I kept the ring on my finger, but I never noticed when it disappeared. It was as if it just... vanished without me realizing.
Something unusual? Now that you ask... Yes, there was! I think I had... a fateful encounter!
An Encounter?

That evening, just as I was about to close the shop, a gentleman passed by. His clothes were a little worn, and he looked exhausted, but... he was so handsome! He had this melancholy air, like a noble knight fallen on hard times in a story!
He shyly asked if I had anything to eat because he was so hungry he could barely walk. Oh my, can you imagine? It was exactly like something out of a novel!
What do I do after that?

I happened to have a ham sandwich for my dinner, so I gave it to him. He ate it so elegantly, then gave me a solemn Thank You and said my kindness had brightened his dreary day. Just thinking about it makes me so happy!
But... my ring disappeared after that. Maybe I dropped it somewhere by accident? That prince-like gentleman couldn't possibly have taken it, could he? No, of course not!

...It makes no sense! Absolutely none! The protective barrier wasn't triggered, and the seal on the chest is completely intact. How could the book simply vanish? This violates the third, fifth, and seventh of the Twelve Fundamental Laws of Protective Magic!

Are you the investigator? Thank goodness! Please, you must help me recover the missing book. It's no ordinary spellbook—the knowledge it contains is extremely dangerous. If misused, the consequences could be catastrophic! I must take it back to Geffen Tower and seal it away.
How did the book go missing?

I... I don't know. I checked countless times. It was in my lockbox, and I even confirmed it was there after arriving in Prontera. But before I was ready to leave for Geffen, it vanished. There were no signs of forced entry whatsoever.
Anything unusual? Everything went according to protocol. If I had to name something that disrupted my carefully planned itinerary... Hmm... there was one insignificant little incident.
What was it?

On my way to the Guild, I spotted a creature in an alley. It was a... uh... Siamese cat. Strictly speaking, these cats are only found in the faraway East. They're extremely rare! Its figure was quite... Ahem! Anyway, it was sunning itself and looked very docile.
And then?
I... I looked around and made sure I wasn't violating the Geffen Code of Public Conduct... Then, out of basic concern for a living creature, I crouched down... and patted it on the head.
Its purring... According to current research, it has a soothing effect on the nerves... But that has absolutely nothing to do with the theft! It was merely a brief, perfectly reasonable Interaction.

Right, there couldn't possibly be a connection! Are you accusing an innocent little kitten purring in the sun of being a thief? Absurd! This must be the work of some sophisticated spatial magic yet unknown to us!
Help... Help me... Water... Just one sip... The desert... shows no mercy to the careless...
Hey, my friend! You're back! Judging by the look on your face, do you have good news for me?
Return the Sword
Wonderful, that's really it! Thank You so much—you've done both me and one of my longtime customers a huge favor!
Come on, tell me—who was it? How did they pull off something so skillful? I still can't figure out how they did it.
Sultry Beauty
Unknown Thief

Wh... what? It was... her? But how...? She sounded so sincere when she praised my smithing... Could it be... was all that just so she could steal from me? Ugh, this hurts worse than failing a +@{1} refinement...
Oh! I get it now! It's one of those "can't say too much" situations, right? Like with certain high-level commissions.
Anyway, getting the weapon back is wonderful news! I, Hollgrehenn, won't forget what you've done. Next time you need equipment refined, I'll give you a discount!
Oh, it's you! What kind of flowers do you need today? ...Hmm? Judging by your expression, is something important going on?
Return the Ring
Oh my gosh! It's my ring! The ring my mother left me! Thank goodness! I really, truly can't thank you enough!
Um... if you don't mind, could you tell me who took it? I'm really curious.
Down-on-His-Luck Hunk
…Huh? That… prince-like gentleman? Th-That can't be…
So... when he said he was starving... and all those words of gratitude... was it all just... just so he could steal Mom's ring? So... there was never any fateful encounter at all...
I understand! You must be trying to protect someone, right? Just like in the knightly tales~

It's okay. Getting the ring back is the best ending I could have hoped for. Thank you for helping me complete this "mission." From now on, whenever you buy flowers from me, I'll always give you twenty percent off~
Investigator! You're back! That look on your face... Could it be...?
Return the Spellbook
Odin be praised, the seal is completely intact... Thank You! You prevented what could have been an academic catastrophe!
Protocol requires me to ask: Have you identified the thief? This is crucial to improving our security measures going forward.
That little cat.
Wh... what? You're accusing that... that Siamese cat with pupils as clear as amber?!

No, that's impossible! It completely contradicts the fundamental principles of Non-Sapient Creature Behavior! It was so docile, and spectral analysis of its purring showed that it was completely relaxed! Could... could all of this have been some kind of higher-dimensional mimicry disguise?!
I see. When dealing with a thief of this caliber, their very identity is classified information that must remain sealed. I understand why you need to keep it confidential.

In any case, you've recovered the forbidden tome and made an invaluable contribution to the stability of the academic community. Please accept my gratitude. From now on, I'll give your research into magical items priority support.
Hey, wait! Prontera is holding a festival soon, and coordinating all the supplies is driving me crazy. I've got a list of errands here. Could you take care of them for me?
First, find Antonio for me. He promised to bring the festival banner back from Morroc, but there's still no sign of him. And while you're at it—
Monsters are overrunning Sograt Desert. Help me take some of them out first.

The banner? According to regulations, I handed it over to the Merchants' Guild for delivery 3 days ago. But the caravan leader said they ran into monsters and got stranded along the way. I was just about to head there Myself.
Since you're here, how about taking care of them for me?

Aorufeng is guarding the formation at the top of the tower. Take the fragment to him. He knows how to fit it back into the base.
You're finally here. Once this fragment is back in place, the magical field beneath the tower will become stable again.
You've worked hard traveling from Geffen to Morroc and all the way back. Geffen owes You one, Adventurer.

Tell You what—I'll prepare a gift for You first. But monsters have been appearing along the delivery route Recent, so clear them out before they trample the gift box.

Ask the Pet Merchant. His little Porings run around the forest all day, so he should know which trees have good wood beneath them.
I'll take care of the lumber! But first, you'll have to drive away those wolves Nearby. Me Porings have been too scared to leave their cages for two days.
These little ones are timid enough already. If you don't help, I'll never get them to tell me where the spicewood is.
I hear you're helping someone prepare a gift. Here, take this dry-cured ham too. When you're out adventuring, nothing's more reassuring than having some meat in your pocket.
Come to think of it, haven't the monsters seemed unusually restless lately? The Monsterologist has been collecting samples. Go have a word with him—he's in the little cabin by the tower.
I can tell from your Battle scars. Recent monster attacks have increased in both frequency and range, perfectly in sync with the tower's magical fluctuations.
But enough about that. The Young Man asked me to tell you that if everything's Ready, he'll be waiting by the fountain. Don't keep him waiting too long.
Not a single thing is missing. From Prontera to Geffen, from the gift to the spicewood and ham... You really helped me gather every last thing.
She'll love it. If you ever need anything, just come find me here by the fountain. My name is Reia. Remember it.

Ahem... Anyway, I really can't Thank You enough. If you hadn't arrived when you did, I'd probably be a skeleton picked clean in that nest by now.
Now that you're all right, let's hurry back. The airship has been waiting for you for ages!
You're right. It was all my fault... Once we get back and organize the cargo, we'll be ready to take off. Let's return to Izlude first. I promise I'll reward you handsomely when we get there!
Need any help?
Of course! How thoughtful of you to ask. I'll be waiting at the harbor, Adventurer. See you there.
We had a little mishap in the desert... Ahem, but our caravan has an excellent Reputation. As soon as we stack this cargo neatly, we can board and depart!
Come, kindhearted Adventurer—^{1}PlayerName^{2}, are you Ready? Let's arrange the cargo together.
Arrange the Cargo
Excellent work, rookie. Thanks to your help, we can take off immediately.
Time is short, so I'll get straight to the point. Our mission is to travel to Sograt Desert and Find the missing Professor Ryan.
We'll take the White Dove cargo airship to Morroc, at the entrance to the desert. If there's anything else you'd like to know, ask me now.
What's so special about the White Dove?
Who exactly is Professor Ryan?
Who commissioned this mission?

Good eye! The White Dove belongs to Valkyrie Airlines and symbolizes the partnership between the Church State and the Republic. It's officially a cargo ship, but it still has a passenger cabin, making it perfect for teams like ours that need to keep a low profile.
His safety is the Quests' highest priority.
That's why we must find him and ensure his safety.
So don't worry so much. Just follow Me, and I'll bring all of you back safely.
All right, no more questions, right? Take your ticket, rookie. Get ready to board.
Oh, right! I almost forgot to give you a Talent Stone! If we run into trouble up there, you'll need some way to defend yourself. This thing will be a huge help, so take it.
All right. Please gather your belongings and board immediately.
Wah... You big dummy! You scared Bobo half to death! Bobo thought you'd hurt your head!
Yes. I'm trying to Find someone. Have you seen a scholar named Ryan Recent? He wears glasses, has terrible eyesight, and is very refined.
Ryan... Glasses, poor eyesight... Is he from Payon? Did he also study abroad in Juno?

He's been staying at the camp for the past week, leaving early and returning late every day. Oh! I even said hello to him before he left this morning. He headed west^{2} of the camp at dawn with his equipment^{1}, saying he was looking for something called [Memory Particles]. He's so stubborn—he wouldn't listen when I told him to find someone to help.
I'll leave the Find the Professor Quests to you for now. I need to report the White Dove's major accident to headquarters. Once that's taken care of, I'll rejoin you.
Come on, ^{1}PlayerName^{2}. It's time for the two of us to shine again.
Phew... Finally, some peace and quiet. Thank You, my friend. These desert Chonchons are even more annoying than monsters. I've never seen you Nearby before. Are you new here?
We're looking for someone.
Yes. We're looking for a middle-aged man with glasses and Yellow hair. Have you seen him?
Was he wearing a suit, too? Someone like that really stands out around here. About two hours ago, I saw him heading west—toward Ant Hell.
Ant Hell? Just hearing that gives me the creeps. What's that old guy doing in a horrible place like that?
Wait, did that Pet of yours just talk? My goodness! Is it a Poring mutant, or perhaps a highly intelligent Demon? It's an invaluable specimen for live dissection... No, for academic research!
What are you staring at, you weirdo?! Don't Approach Me! And... I'm not his Pet!
Hold still! Let Me measure your head circumference and the frequency of those wingbeats! I've never seen such an intelligent Deviling...
Let's go! This guy's crazy. The Professor went that way, so let's get out of here!
You didn't Find him? That old man is as slippery as a desert snake. I also sent a seasoned Adventurer to search Nearby Ant Hell. It's no place for rookies to wander around.
I'll send you a Notification if I Discover a Clue. For now, stay by the campfire and don't wander off.
You know, the true core of your Second Job combat power lies in the new skills you've acquired.
Whoa! There are more new moves to learn? Like Summon a giant storm with one wave of your hand, or stomp so hard that Ant Hell collapses?
Mastering your job takes steady effort. If you want to become a renowned Adventurer, you must start by mastering your new Second Job skills.
Excellent. It seems you've fully grasped the essence of your new power. Knowing how to review and Allocate Skill Points. shows that you're beginning to think like a true Adventurer.
But mastering skills isn't enough. After your Second Job, the new ^{1}[Talent]^{2} System has been unlocked. Go—this is the key to determining the limits of your abilities.
You're back? The scout I sent just returned. They found Professor Ryan's Footprints on the first floor of Ant Hell. He should be inside, but we still don't know his exact location.
Ugh, that place sounds terrifying. Let's wait for Boya and Wuhler to return, then go together.
Those two are probably fighting Phreeoni Nearby, so I doubt they can get away.
I shouldn't send a rookie like you, but you've just completed your Job Advance and seem capable. The Professor can't defend himself, so every second counts.
Do you want to go? It's your call. But if any ants bite Me, I'm setting the whole cave on fire...
Of course we're going.
Brave of you. That's an Eden Group member for you. If you're in danger inside Ant Hell, ask Fiennes for help. You've met before.
Look! I think there's something on the ground!
Could it belong to the Professor? Hurry, let's take a look.
Hey! You're Professor Ryan, right? Are you okay?
Hey there! Good to see you again.
What are you doing here?
I'm the poor sap Hawke sent to Find the Professor and collect samples along the way. Allow Me to introduce myself. My name is Fiennes, and I'm an alchemy scholar.
My goodness... You saw that, didn't you? Magnificent! Was that Maya's mimicry transformation? She actually assumed the form of a human woman! This is a miracle of monster biology!
Hey, you have time to study this?! That giant ant freak carried off the Professor as emergency rations! We have to save him!
Easy, easy—hear Me out. Ant Hell is really just the outer edge of the ant nest. Maya lives in its deepest reaches, where her brood chamber is also located.

The passages there form a complicated maze, so you'll never Find the entrance on your own. But... a [Pathfinder Ant] can smell Maya's unique pheromones. Follow it, and it'll lead you straight to her lair.
Here's the plan: take out a few Nearby ants and bring Me fragments of their bodies. Any Material will do! I'll catalyze it with alchemy and make you an obedient Pathfinder Ant.
We're gathering Material again? Will this really work? Can the Professor hold out that long...?
Trust in science, you little devil of a Poring. Hurry back—I guarantee results!
Excellent! This Material is incredibly fresh! Watch closely—this is advanced alchemy!
After a blinding flash and a cloud of acrid smoke, a strange, red-bodied ant with twitching antennae appeared in Phines's hand.

It worked! This is the Pathfinder Ant. When you reach a fork in the road, Release it, and it'll automatically track Maya's pheromones. All you have to do is follow it. Notes: If it crawls into a hole, you'll have to follow it inside.
What? We have to crawl into a hole?! Oh my gosh, it's not going to be full of ants, is it?

It'll definitely be dangerous in there. It is Maya's lair, after all. But... it'd be such a shame if those ants hurt you, little one. By the way, is your Pet for sale? Name your price! I'll even trade you a newly refined, high-grade Pet!
Bobo is my friend.
You lunatic! Are you even listening? I already told you I'm not his Pet!
What a terrible waste... Fine, until we meet again. And we will meet again, little Poring. I know we will.
Nicely done. After rescuing someone right from under Maya's nose, you've proven that you have the Eligibility to take on classified Quests of this caliber.
Ahem. Thank You for your help. I made a Record of the Magic fluctuation Data along the way. It'll be very useful for my current research.
All right, as long as everyone's safe. I don't want to spend another second in this wretched place. Pack up—we're returning to camp immediately.
You all go on ahead. ^{1}PlayerName^{2} and I still have something to take care of. We'll return later.
All right. This area is dangerous, so be careful.
Heh-heh, dummy! After seeing how you handled that crisis, I fully acknowledge your strength.
Let's form a pact. Then, whenever danger strikes, we can fight together.
You're back? I heard you pulled the Professor right out of Maya's jaws. Not bad—you've certainly got some serious skills.
Quests complete. Hawke, Thank You for the intelligence and backup.

That's what old friends are for. Oh, right, ^{1}PlayerName^{2}. Phines asked me to give you this thing. He called it a "Pet Incubator," but didn't explain how to use it. He just said to return to Prontera and ask a Pet Merchant about it.
That crazy alchemist? He actually gave you a gift? He's not after Me again, is he?
Enough talk. Take it. Now, both of you, Return to Town. Stop standing around in this desert wind.
Let's set out and return to Prontera.
Ha! Didn't expect to see Me again, did you?

Come on, hand me the incubator. This is the latest achievement in monster ecology. Just put an egg inside, adjust the temperature, and you'll soon Hatch a little creature that'll obey your every command.
What kind of dangerous experiment are you running this time? If you Hatch some weird tentacle monster, I'll be the first to burn your shop down!
No, no, no! This alchemical hatching method is all the rage across the entire Midgard continent. Go try it!
Congratulations! You've learned the secret of Pet Hatching.
This isn't just a Normal sidekick. It can help you in Battle, boost your stats, and even accompany you into high-Difficulty towers later on. It's incredibly useful!
But... now that you have a new Pet, why not give Bobo to Me? I promise I'll take good care of Bobo~
Hey, quit bragging! These guys look like a bunch of dimwits. There's no way they're stronger than Me!

^{1}PlayerName^{2}, you're here. Captain Aikuni just sent word that she's swamped with work. From now on, if we need someone to run errands, lend a hand, or venture Into Peril, we're free to send you.
What does she mean by "run errands"? She's gone a little too far.
Quiet! You there—the black... soot sprite. Stay away from my experimental equipment.

I've actually been studying the "Nails of World Law" appearing throughout Prontera. I believe they're connected to Juperos's long-lost "Thought Form" technology. Take a look at this. It's a sample I collected in the Ant Cavern.
Handle it carefully. This is extremely valuable research Material... even if it does look like nothing more than a glowing mass of Magic.
You've already seen the vision the compass showed you, haven't you?
What is that?
It was a glimpse of the future. But that isn't its only purpose. Keep it safe—it will play an even more important role in the future.
As for everything else... I can't tell you much right now. All I can say is that everything you've experienced so far is merely the first measure of a grand symphony.
And You will be the only one capable of deciding their fate.
This place is beautiful! It's much more comfortable than ^{1}PlayerName^{2}'s Backpack~ But... why does it feel so familiar?
It's almost time. You should go back.
The next time we meet... I hope you'll bring Me a more interesting Story.
Remember—falling is not the end. It is simply another beginning.
What happened to you just now? You suddenly froze like a statue, and you even knocked over and shattered the "Thought Form" storage vial! I thought you'd caught some kind of desert fever...
Sigh... It took me so much effort to extract that sample. Never mind. As long as you're all right. You've had a long day, so go get some rest. I need to reorganize the Data anyway.
It's finally over! Today was even more exhausting than being chased by a Peco Peco! Time to get some rest~
Adventurer, it has been far too long. Your mind and body have undergone a complete transformation since you were an inexperienced novice. At last, the time for your Advance has come.
Since you're Ready, I shall perform the Tier Two Job Advance Ritual and let the power of the gods fully merge with your blood.
Come. With your new job, You will face even greater Challenges.
Congratulations, Adventurer. As of today, you have officially advanced to Trans. 2nd. Greater power brings greater responsibility, and it's time to improve your equipment.
Go see Hollgrehenn. He has a gift from Tritura Academy for every Beginner.
Ha-ha! I knew it was you! Long time no see, Adventurer! I heard you reached Trans. 2nd? Your growth has been nothing short of remarkable!
That's right. Tritura Academy does work with me, so every Adventurer can come here to receive a gift.
It's time for you to Craft your own advanced equipment. Here—this high-grade Material is a gift from the Academy. Use it for practice. Go on, give it a try! I bet you'll Craft a golden Legend!
Unforgivable... The Church clearly promised to protect the research equipment, and look what happened! I spent three years calibrating that precision instrument!
Come now, Professor, please calm down. It's just an instrument. We'll certainly compensate you for it...
Compensate me? How? That was the only prototype on the entire Midgard continent! Without it, my research into the "Nails of World Law" will be set back by at least three years!
Er... this was indeed our oversight. But our investigators have already taken a team to pursue the Clue. Please try to calm down. We'll take responsibility and recover it.
Calm down? I don't believe a word of this irresponsible investigation! If you fail to recover it, which of you can replace years of my Research Results? The only person I trust now is my assistant.
Sigh... Why put yourself through this? Fine, if you insist. We found this at the scene. The thief must have dropped it.
You're the Professor's new assistant, right? Here, take this. This bow tie was left behind at the crime scene as evidence.

Take this to the first floor of the Culvert and meet Fervor, an investigator with the Knight Order. He's a glutton, but he'll definitely be able to track the scent. Now hurry. All this scolding is giving me a headache.
This bow tie... Why does it smell so bad? Don't tell me some Vagrant stole the device. This is going to be a lot of work.
Huh? There's no one Nearby. Where's the investigator?
Why don't we call out his name? Maybe he'll come out when he hears us. What do you think?
Good idea.
Okay, here goes!
I can't believe it... The investigator is a dog! Can that Knight really be trusted?
Woof! Woof, woof!
Okay, okay~ It says it really is an investigator with the Knight Order and that we shouldn't look down on it.
How can you understand a dog's Language?
Good question. No idea. Maybe I'm just exceptionally gifted. After all, I'm the smartest Deviling on the entire continent of Midgard.
Woof! Woof woof woof!
It says you have some evidence on you, and it wants to sniff it. It probably means that bow tie, right?

Tsk, tsk. Who left these Clothes here? Look at this fabric—there's barely more than a bandage, and it's covered in cat hair... Just how filthy is the owner? Could the device have been stolen by some sexy cat Demon wearing this?
(Frantically paws at the ground, tail spinning like a propeller, and barks wildly at the vest) Woof, woof, woof! Woof! Woof, woof, woof, woof!
Hmph. It says there's no mistaking the scent. The thief who stole the device left this behind. I hate to admit it, but this border collie really does have a sharp nose.
Since it's so excited, I suppose we can follow our dear investigator. If we follow this scent, we should be able to catch that perverted little thief.
(Presses its nose close to the cardboard box, sniffing frantically and barking urgently) Woof! Woof, woof, woof! Woof, woof!
Oh my gosh! What the heck is this now?! A cardboard box full of sand? What are those little logs inside? Ugh, they stink!
It looks like a litter box.
What??? You mean that's cat poop?!
(Sticks out his tongue, about to lick the "Treasure" in the cardboard box) Woof, woof, woof!
Stop! Fervor, don't you dare! You can't eat that! It's poop! Poop, understand?! Aaaah, I'm going blind!
Is this really a Clue? I bet this dumb dog only tricked us into coming here because he wanted a snack!
Fine... For the sake of that precious device, I'll trust this glutton one last time. Let's go, before I throw up...
(Looks eagerly toward the Teleport portal Nearby) Woof, woof! Woof, woof, woof, woof!
We have to go down another floor? What the heck is at the end of this Culvert...?
Ugh, No idea. Can this dumb dog really be trusted? Let's go... But if there are any more "poop Clues" on this floor, I'm going on strike!
Huh? What's wrong, Fervor? Isn't that just some passerby? Why are you stopping him?
D-Don't bite me! I'm an academic! I'm studying... the population distribution of urban cockroaches! Yes, cockroaches! I'm a cockroach researcher!
A cockroach researcher?
What are you doing here?
It's true! I'm not lying! Oh... I remember now! I put two meat sandwiches in my pockets this morning as bait for giant cockroaches. The smell must have attracted this dog!
Here... give them to it! Just don't let it bite me!
Hey, Fervor! Have you no shame?! You forgot all about the job for two lousy sandwiches? That guy is a criminal!
At least it's Regular food this time. I still haven't forgotten how you snuck a bite of that "chocolate bar" from the litter box. That was so embarrassing.
Woof! Woof, woof, woof, woof!
Em...
What did it say?
That's disgusting. It says it isn't full, and... that the sandwiches aren't as Delicious as the "chocolate bar."
Woof! Woof, woof, woof, woof! Woof, woof, woof!
Enough about food! You've been eating nonstop this entire time. Are you here to work or hit the buffet? Doesn't the Knight Order feed you?
Fervor, could you please focus on the job? If food distracts you from your work again, I'll... I'll shave off all your fur!
Woof, woof, woof, woof!
Hey, Fervor, why did you stop again? Did you smell something Delicious this time?
A set of Clothes and a pair of Shoes are lying on the ground. They look kind of familiar...
Huh? The guy vanished and left his Clothes here? What's going on?
These Clothes look familiar.

Wait... Aren't these the Clothes that guy was wearing? What respectable researcher would come down to this stinking drain, strip off all his Clothes and Shoes, and leave them here? He obviously felt guilty and ran away!

(Spins through the air in fury) I knew that guy was acting suspicious! Forget those stupid sandwiches—he must've stolen something and deliberately used them as bait to throw Fervor off his trail! Fervor, sniff around! Which way did he go?
Meow, meow, meow, meow... Meow, meow!
Huh? No wonder they found us. Louie, Katie says these people have its bow tie! How despicable!
You're the ones who stole the Professor's things! Who's really despicable here?
Everyone, please, calm down~ Why all the hostility? Since we each have something the other party wants, why don't we resolve this in a more Peaceful manner?
Do we have to? Why not just beat them until they lose their memories...?
Allow me to give you a Regular introduction. I am Louie von Schillerkens, a poor soul failed by the current system and... well, the strategic advisor of this little group.
We're willing to give you what you want in exchange. But now that you've Discovered our secret, we can't simply let you leave. How about this...?

Let's play a game. The Rules are Easy. The three of us will hide inside these three Bells, and you'll have to guess where each of us is. Guess correctly, and we'll give you the item. Guess wrong... and you'll have to Join us, starting as our lowest-ranking lackey!
Then let the game begin!
So, in accordance with our Alternate plan, we've decided to move out immediately. Until we meet again~
We've got the bow tie! You can keep that useless piece of junk!
It's back? Oh my gosh... You really brought it back in one piece!
That kind of efficiency would put those idiots in the Knight Order to shame. I knew giving the job to someone reliable would work better than making them fill out a hundred Request forms.

Fortunately, the core parts are intact, but the Control components are slightly misaligned. Go take care of whatever You need to do. I have to start the Repair and calibration immediately, and it'll take at least three days and nights.
That's it? You're just dismissing us? We crawled through filthy sewers and saw things we were never meant to see...
Oh, good work. Um... take your payment. That'll be all.
You're here! I desperately need your help.
The evening before last, a caravan from Juno was attacked by Baphomet Nearby the Hidden Forest. That damned Monster is still occupying the area and blocking the road.
Worse yet, the core part I ordered was on that wagon. Without that component, this instrument is nothing but scrap metal. There's no way to start it.

How absurd! Those church officials guard the Nail of Discipline all day and refuse to let us Approach it, yet they allow Monsters to plunder cargo right under their noses? This is a complete dereliction of duty...

I have no choice but to rely on you, ^{1}PlayerName^{2}. Of all your Quests, this one is very dangerous, but I can submit a Request to the Rune-Midgarts royal family for a special stipend as your reward. Please bring the part back!
You're here on behalf of Professor Ryan, aren't you? How humiliating... We accepted such a large commission from the Professor, yet couldn't even protect half a wagonload of parts.
That damned Baphomet descended from the sky, and even fighting for our lives did no good. He scattered the cargo everywhere, and now no one dares to retrieve it.
Curse you, Baphomet! If I were only stronger, I'd skin that beast alive!
This is it... the flow Control valve, completely intact! You actually took it back from Baphomet... No, I mean, retrieved it.
Excellent. With this, I can finish the Repair of my device. Meet Me at the Knight Order outpost northeast of the city. I need to perform the final test at the Nail of Discipline.
Hey! That's it? Aren't you going to praise us? We just fought a bull-headed Monster!

Efficiency is a fundamental quality for any scholar. Arriving late could skew the Data... And stop calling it a "bull-headed Monster." That's Baphomet. Its scientific name is "Minotaur." Your terminology is terribly imprecise.
You're here. Perfect timing—the instrument has just finished starting up, so we can begin the field test.
Help Me move this instrument beside the base of the Stone Pillar. Handle it with extreme care.

Once it's in position, we can perform the most critical step. Connect the mechanical flexible arm on top of the machine to the surface of the Stone Pillar. Then it can extract the energy flowing inside the Nail of Discipline.
What exactly is this huge black Stone? Won't making Contact with it harm us?
Enough nonsense! This is a serious experiment! Hurry—the energy window will only last a few minutes. If we miss it, we'll have to wait until tomorrow.
Stop. This is the sealed area surrounding the Nail of Discipline. Unauthorized personnel are strictly forbidden to Approach.
I'm the Professor's assistant.
So you're with that deranged scholar... Hmph. I can't believe they're allowing an outsider from Juno to tamper with something vital to the kingdom's security.
Someone from Juno? Isn't the Professor a scholar of the Rune Kingdom?

He spent more than a decade in Juno studying the principles of Magic, filling his head with dangerous, heretical theories. How does that make him any different from a foreigner? Still, I have my orders, so I won't stop you.
Go on, but be quick and exercise caution when making Contact. If you Destroy this miracle, the consequences will be far beyond anything you can bear.
Hmph. You talk as if you're so responsible, but weren't you the ones who lost the instrument last time?
That was indeed the Knight Order's responsibility. But I'm standing guard now, and I won't allow such a blunder to happen again. Go on and complete your mission as quickly as possible.
My name is Bragis Skjald, a bard... and the chronicler of this timeline's epic.
This timeline is on the verge of destruction, and you're the only one who can resolve this crisis.
It may sound cliché, but the way the Nail of Natural Law responds to you is all the proof we need.
Your compass... It should begin collecting Soul Echoes soon, shouldn't it? They're more important than you realize.
Farewell, my friend. When you're ready, we'll meet again, and I'll tell you more.
Calm down and tell me what happened.
Sir, a strange Stone platform suddenly appeared in the Pyramid area this morning! The Monsters there have also become unusually agitated and extremely aggressive!
Oh? What do you mean by "suddenly appeared"?
Well... it simply materialized out of nowhere, almost as if a divine miracle had descended...
What's causing the Monsters' unusual agitation?

Ever since the stone platform appeared this morning, the Monsters in the Pyramid area have become extremely agitated for some unknown reason. Several Adventurers have already been injured! Our squad was sent to clear them out, but we can't handle them at all!
Understood. Take Me there immediately so I can provide Utility support.
Wait! I'm coming too!
Professor Ryan, we're carrying out official duties. This has nothing to do with you.
I don't care. That thing appeared in exactly the same way as the Nail of Discipline, and at nearly the same time. There must be a connection. I have to investigate immediately.
Why are you looking at Me? Didn't the queen order you to give Me your full cooperation? Is that a problem?
...Of course not. Fine, you can come with us.
^{1}PlayerName^{2}, I'm heading there now. Come over as soon as you have time. I'm sure we'll have plenty of work for you.
Stop! The first floor of the Pyramid has been declared a restricted area. Normal Adventurers are forbidden from entering. It's far too dangerous right now.
The Relic... Are you with the Professor and Knight Isis? That object is deep inside the Pyramid. Ever since it appeared, the Monsters here have been agitated beyond Control.
No worries. We're here specifically to deal with that Relic! I'm not afraid of the Monsters here. ^{1}PlayerName^{2} can definitely drive them away, right?
All right. You're wearing Fine equipment, so you must be capable. In that case, could you do Me a favor? My comrades should be fighting the Monsters Nearby...
What is it?
If you encounter them inside, Please help them. The Monsters' ATK is absurdly high right now, and I'm afraid they won't last much longer!
Thank You so much, Adventurer. I've marked the Relic's approximate location for you. Be careful.
Thank You for your help! No idea what has gotten into these Drainliars, but they've become terrifyingly aggressive... It's too dangerous here. You should turn back immediately.
Go back? You've got to be kidding! We're old man Ryan's assistants, and we're here specifically to protect him. Monsters at this level are no problem at all~

Oh... You're with the scholar who came with the Knight? No wonder you're so confident. If you're determined to move Forward, then Please be careful. Ever since that glowing object appeared, every Monster in the Pyramid has gone Berserk, as if they'd been guzzling strong liquor.
Which direction is the Relic? Could you mark it on our map? Thank You!
Understood. I've marked the direction of the Relic on your map. Good luck, Adventurer... May Odin be with you.
Th-Thank You! Why would you venture into a place like this? The entire Pyramid is under lockdown. It's extremely dangerous here!
We're here to protect Professor Ryan. Once we accept a request, we see it through to the end. We also rescued several of your colleagues just now. They're safe.

So you're with the Professor... Please be extremely careful. It seems Pharaoh, the most vicious Monster of Legend within the Pyramid, has awakened. If you encounter it, your chances of survival will be slim.
Uh... Pharaoh? What is that? Is it strong? If it gets in our way, we'll chop it up and burn it for firewood, right, ^{1}PlayerName^{2}?
Understood. The Relic should be in this direction. I've marked it on your map.
It's terrifying. The closer we get to the Relic, the further the Monsters spiral out of Control. That Pharaoh we just saw looked as though it had crawled straight out of hell...
After the sarcophagus dragged you away, Pharaoh disappeared as well. If you hadn't stepped Forward and lured it away, all of us would probably be nothing but bleached bones in the desert by now.

I'm sorry. My attitude at the City Gate was No good. I take back what I said—you truly are an admirable Adventurer. Thank you for everything. You didn't suffer any internal injuries, did you? That suction looked impossible to survive.
Hehe, not bad for a big dummy. ^{1}PlayerName^{2} is incredibly lucky, especially since they still have to take me out for dessert.
Thank goodness you're all right. That Spatial Distortion caused quite a commotion. I was afraid you'd been pulled into Pharaoh's dimension and wouldn't make it back.
Want to hear about my new Discover?
All right
No

The runic structure and residual energy on this Relic are identical to the Nail of Discipline Outside the City of Prontera. That can't be a coincidence. There must be some deeper connection between them.

You're the only one who managed to Activate the Stone Pillar in the city. I spent months tinkering with it and got no response. So... would you like to try touching this? Don't worry, I have Isis standing by over there. If it throws you back, his sturdy frame should probably—maybe—be able to catch you.
You stinky old man! What do you mean, "should probably—maybe"? If he doesn't catch my Adventurer, they'll be squashed flat! No good!
Stay out of my research, you black sootball freak! I'm asking ^{1}PlayerName^{2}!
Hahaha! That's my enlightened, motivated, and courageous Chief assistant!
Hmph. I think you've really lost your mind...
We meet again. It seems you've found the second piece of the puzzle.
Breathing is normal, but there's no consciousness... Most likely... a protective coma caused by a concussion? If we wait a little longer, they'll wake up... right?
This is all your fault! You insisted they touch that stupid Stone! Now ^{1}PlayerName^{2} has brain damage! What are we going to do?!
Oof... Theoretically, an impact of this intensity shouldn't cause anything more serious... right?
If the head trauma poses a risk of Suffocation, would you like me to perform rescue breathing? I am prepared to do so, even at the cost of my dignity.
Uh... right! According to the Gold four-minute rule, we must intervene. Knight, you're up!
All right. For honor and duty...
Y-you're okay?
^{1}PlayerName^{2}, you're finally awake! I was worried sick!
Phew... Thank goodness you woke up in time. We almost...
Almost what?
Nothing, nothing. We were just discussing having this esteemed Knight carry you back to Prontera if you didn't wake up.
Hahaha! Yes, exactly. Since you're okay, I'll be going. I still have a mission to carry out.
Phew, you're finally awake! You really scared me... I never expected the recoil to be so powerful that it would knock you unconscious.

Still, your unconsciousness proved quite valuable. It confirmed my theory once again—you may be the only person in the world capable of activating these things. The Church has already taken the Relic away and placed it in temporary storage at the palace.

All right, you've been through one danger after another, so you must be exhausted. I'm a VIP member at the Oak Inn in southern Prontera. Go rest there and give them my name. They'll arrange their best room for you.
Hey! You stingy old man! ^{1}PlayerName^{2} got hurt because of you, and all you're offering is a room for the night?

Of course! That's already the finest treatment available. Now get going. I'll return to the laboratory and organize the Data, and you should catch up on sleep. Get plenty of rest—who knows what strange things will happen tomorrow?
Welcome to the Oak Inn! Are you here for a meal or a room? Or perhaps a little drink~?
A room! Put it on that stinky old Professor Rhein's tab! He sent us.
Ah, the professor is one of our premium VIP members. He mentioned the two of you and specifically asked us to prepare a quiet room by the window on the second floor. He said you needed a good rest.
You think back on everything you've experienced over the Recent few days. None of it feels real.
As your thoughts wander, drowsiness overtakes you, and at last you close your eyes...
I've been waiting for you, Adventurer. I'm a Monsterologist dedicated to creating a Record of every creature's ecology.

I'm compiling an unprecedented Encyclopedia of Monsters. But I don't need a few scraps of fur—I need comprehensive Data. Listen: travel far and wide, hunt monsters, Kill as many as you can, and bring their information back to me.
Only sufficient numbers will let me take my research deeper, and the deeper my research goes, the more amazing your rewards will be. We both win.
All right, go give it a try.
Good to see you again, Adventurer. You've managed to Level-up your equipment incredibly quickly. You must have been fighting for your life out there. Excellent work!

Now that you've advanced, there's something I have to teach you—Refine! It's Midgard's greatest form of "legal gambling." Come on, hand over your equipment and let's see if we can smash it to pieces... Er, I mean, send it soaring to new heights!
Uh-oh. Teaching someone to gamble is asking to get struck by lightning~
Ahem... Don't talk nonsense. Remember, this is 30% LUK and 70% Fortify. Don't blame me if it breaks. After all, I'm just a humble Blacksmith who "delivers" the Goddess of Fortune's blessings.
But don't worry too much. There's a beginner protection period, so the Success Rate is extremely high for your first few attempts!
Today, I also want to tell you about a special event called the Commendation Vault.
This isn't Battle training. It's a way to Obtain Resources. By participating, you'll have a Chance to earn plenty of money and EXP.
Money and EXP? What a sweet deal! Bobo wants to join too!
Come. Now I'll teach you how to unlock the Commendation Vault event.
Hello, Adventurer! Our company is hosting a televised competition called Kafra Survivor Showdown. Come give it a try—the last contestant standing will win a fantastic grand prize!
Let me show you how to register for the event~
We meet again, my dear Adventurer, ^{1}PlayerName^{2}. Do you remember the compass I gave you? You've carried it with you all this time, but it has yet to reveal its true power.

To Activate its deeper power, you must collect something called Soul Echo. These are the memories and powerful Emotions that living beings leave behind in the world. Each holds a unique frequency, making them exceptionally rare.
Let me show you how to Insert these echoes into the compass. Awaken its true potential.
Hello, we meet again. Don't ask why I've come to this scorching desert. To witness the growth of an Excellent prospect, these old bones of mine must travel far and wide.
Wow, it's you again! We've gotten lots of new equipment Recent. What do you think? Do we look stronger?
Equipment alone proves nothing. I can sense power surging within you, still not fully under control. It's time for your Second Job Change.
Come, Kill some Nearby monsters and show me your current strength.
Excellent. Your control over your STR is much steadier than when we first met. Your trials in this desert have truly transformed you.
Remember, the Second Job isn't the end. It's your ticket to even harsher adventures. From this day forward, you'll shoulder greater responsibilities. Don't disappoint me or those who support you.
That's amazing! After your Job Advance, will you be able to carry little Me to victory too? I don't want to hide in the back and cheer every time.
All right, let's begin. Place your hand on the Book of Job Advance, and I'll guide you through your Second Job.
What astonishing growth! You're ready for your third job change. Continue onward along your chosen career path!

Gloom Over Dragon Sarcophagus Isle

In the waters surrounding the continent of Midgard lies a little-known island. It appears on no sea chart, and only ships that have lost their way occasionally stumble upon it. Yet no crew dares linger there, for terrifying, thunderous roars have echoed from the island's depths for as long as anyone can remember.
 
Legend holds that the dragon Fafnir is sealed deep within the island. Once a descendant of the giants, he was slain by a descendant of Odin for his insatiable greed for treasure. After Ragnarök, he returned from the underworld to Midgard, transformed into a decaying dragon driven by nothing but greed. To stop Fafnir's plunder and slaughter, people built fortresses, Turrets, and magic formations across the nameless island. Using gold as bait, they ultimately sealed him away through tremendous Devotion. Thus, the island came to be known as Dragon Sarcophagus Isle.

Centuries have since passed, and the seal's power has begun to wane. The roars from the island grow more deafening by the day, while monsters drawn by the dragon's call gather nearby and relentlessly attack the seal.

Fafnir, the dragon once thought safely sealed away, has lost none of his greed. His power stirs deep within Dragon Sarcophagus Isle, threatening the Peace of the continent.

Faced with this threat, the Guild has issued a call to arms. To protect the continent of Midgard and prevent Fafnir from unleashing another catastrophe, brave Adventurers must be assembled. These heroes will form a dragon-slaying force, travel to Dragon Sarcophagus Isle, and challenge Fafnir once more for the sake of the continent's future.
To restore the seal, keep the greedy dragon contained, and protect the Peace of the continent of Midgard, the Guild must gather the bravest Adventurers into a dragon-slaying force and send them to Dragon Sarcophagus Isle to challenge the dragon once more.
